subject: Re: Alignment: SDK matrix, API compatibility, and onboarding timeline
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@clearbyte.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@clearbyte.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-18T14:05:00-05:00
Subject: Next steps + SDK/PoC outline (recap from today's call)

Alex/Priya — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before I loop in engineering for the trial: 

Pain points you shared
- Current inference costs spiking with batch jobs; unpredictable tail latency for production chat at 99th percentile.
- On-prem data residency requirement for PII-containing queries (must keep logs inside GCP us-central1).
- Need integration path for a Java-heavy stack and a separate Python ETL pipeline.

Success criteria (what Clearbyte needs to call the pilot successful)
1) 40–50% reduction in per-token compute cost vs current baseline on equivalent throughput.
2) 99th percentile latency <= 300ms for typical chat sessions under expected concurrency.
3) Certify that inference logs never leave your VPC (private deployment option) and E2E audit trails are available.

Technical details we captured
- Current stack: Java Spring Boot microservice for chat frontend; Python for batch ingestion and vector indexing.
- Preferred SDKs: Java (primary), Python (secondary).
- Models: evaluating a Llama-variant family; we recommended an initial quantized variant for cost testing.

Proposal / PoC plan (high level)
- Week 0 (this week): exchange minimal access artifacts (API keys for sandbox/isolated env), sign POA for trial, and complete the onboarding form.
- Week 1: Redwood provides a dedicated sandbox with Java and Python SDK samples + a compatibility matrix (attached).
- Week 2–3: Integration work — simple inference calls + prefix caching enabled, run synthetic perf tests (we'll provide stress scripts).
- Week 4: Joint evaluation against success criteria; review telemetry and cost estimates, decide on next steps for Dedicated or Private deployment.

Owners
- Redwood: Rafael (solution lead), Ben (onboarding engineer), Marissa (account exec).
- Clearbyte: Alex (technical lead), Priya (procurement/pm).

Attachments: redwood-poc-outline-20270118.pdf (PoC tasks and acceptance criteria), sdk_compatibility_matrix.csv (SDK language support + required runtime).

Immediate asks for Clearbyte
- Confirm SDK priority (Java yes/no), a technical contact for credentials, and availability for a 30-min kickoff with Ben next Tuesday.
- Complete the onboarding form: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/form?engagement=CLR-2027-0013

I'll pause here and wait for Alex/Priya to confirm owners + kickoff slot — I can then schedule the sandbox env and share access details.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172

---

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@clearbyte.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya@clearbyte.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-18T16:28:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Next steps + SDK/PoC outline (recap from today's call)

Rafael — thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SDK priority: Java is primary. Python SDK for batch testing is necessary but lower priority.
- Technical contact: I'm copying our infra lead (forwarding separately to include his direct email) — he will own the creds and sandbox connectivity.
- Data residency: we must confirm that logs can be routed to our GCP project and retained there; happy to review a short runbook or architecture note.
- Trial expectations: we would like the PoC to include a brief run of our real traffic replay (anonymized) to validate latency under load. Can you confirm whether the sandbox supports that without leaking any payloads?

I can do a kickoff Tuesday at 11:00am PT. Priya, can you confirm procurement and DocuSign readiness?

Thanks,
Alex Turner
CTO (interim), Clearbyte Inc.
alex.turner@clearbyte.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@clearbyte.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@clearbyte.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-18T18:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Next steps + SDK/PoC outline (recap from today's call)

Alex — great to meet you (virtually). Quick technical notes and owners from Redwood's side: 

- Sandbox capabilities: the dedicated sandbox supports Java and Python SDKs, private VPC peering to GCP us-central1, and a no-egress mode so payloads never leave the peered network. We'll confirm the exact networking ACLs in the kickoff.
- Data handling: we can route logs to an S3/GCS bucket in your project and provide a signed URL lifecycle policy; SOC2 artifact pack and our ATO checklist attached upon request.
- Load testing: we support replaying an anonymized request stream — you'll run the replay from your side to the sandbox endpoint; we never store raw payloads unless explicitly enabled.

Proposed detailed milestones (concrete dates):
- 2027-01-19: Kickoff + credential exchange (30 min).
- 2027-01-21: Sandbox access + Java SDK sample integrated (initial smoke tests).
- 2027-01-25: End-to-end replay + perf run (we'll run in coordination with your infra lead).
- 2027-01-28: Joint review; measure latency/cost and evaluate pass/fail vs success criteria.

I'll own sandbox setup. Rafael will own overall PoC coordination; Marissa will manage commercial/contract touches.

Attachments I can provide after kickoff: SOC2 type II summary, network runbook, and a sample Terraform snippet for VPC peering.

Ben Carter
Onboarding Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Priya Sharma <priya@clearbyte.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@clearbyte.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-19T09:42:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Next steps + SDK/PoC outline (recap from today's call)

Thanks everyone — confirming a few items from procurement: 

- DocuSign: procurement is ready to sign a short PoC SOW (30 days) pending final cost estimate from Marissa. Please send the SOW draft to procurement@clearbyte.com.
- Kickoff: Tuesday 2027-01-19 at 11:00am PT works for our team. Alex's infra lead (Samir) will join.
- Security artifacts: please send SOC2 summary and the network runbook ahead of the kickoff so Samir can pre-approve peering.

Two small asks for Ben/Rafael before kickoff: 
1) Share exact Java SDK package name and Maven coordinates so our build engineer can add it to the repo.
2) Confirm the sandbox URL pattern and whether authentication uses API key or short-lived mTLS certs.

I'll look out for the SOW and the SOC2 doc. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Priya Sharma
Procurement Manager, Clearbyte Inc.
procurement@clearbyte.com
